facts.fact: Tech Africa News says the NITDA Sovereign Data Guidelines mandate that data generated, owned or controlled by the Nigerian government be hosted domestically, with foreign hosting only by explicit regulatory approval.

Tech Africa News says NITDA Cloud and CBN directives, effective January 2027, enforce in-country hosting for sensitive government data and require all payment transaction data generated in Nigeria to stay on domestic servers.
facts.system: NITDA Cloud guidelines and CBN directives
